# Load

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

load("~/Documents/bhCRR/inst/ClinTall/MULLI-T-ALL-GM-Teachey_outcome_data_simplified_CNV_SNV.Rdata")
```

```{r}
dat <- annot
dat_gexp <- gexp %>%
  select(row.names(dat))
```

# Select columns

```{r}
dat_simple <- dat %>%
  select(Age.at.Diagnosis.in.Years,
         Sex,
         Race,
         Ethnicity,
         Insurance,
         Tumor.Specimen.Type,
         CNS.Status,
         Risk.Group,
         ETP.STATUS,
         Day.29.morphologic.Response, Day.29.MRD,
         Treatment.Arm,
         OS,
         OS.status,
         Cause.of.Death,
         EFS,
         EFS.status,
         Event.Type,
         DFS,
         DFS.status)%>%
  mutate(MRD = case_when(Day.29.MRD < 1 ~ "<1%",
                                        Day.29.MRD <= 10 ~ "1-10%",
                                        Day.29.MRD > 10 ~ ">10%"))%>%
  mutate(Death.Type = case_when(Cause.of.Death %in% 
                                  c("Due to this disease") ~ "Primary Disease",
                                Cause.of.Death %in% 
                                  c("ARDS following Hdat",
                                    "chronic graft versus host disease.",
                                    "Mucor in BMT",
                                    "Multi-organ system failure BMT",
                                    "Multisystem failure  post BMT.",
                                    "Pseudomonas and Candida in BMT",
                                    "pulmonary GVHD.",
                                    "VOD") ~ "Transplant Complication",
                                !is.na(Cause.of.Death) ~ "Other"))%>%
  mutate(Induction.Status = case_when(Day.29.morphologic.Response == "M1" ~ "Success",
                                      Day.29.morphologic.Response == "M2" ~ "Intermediate",
                                      Day.29.morphologic.Response == "M3" ~ "Failure"))
 

dat_outcomes <- dat_simple %>%select(Day.29.morphologic.Response, Day.29.MRD, Cause.of.Death, OS, OS.status, EFS, EFS.status, Event.Type, DFS, DFS.status)
```

## Label

```{r}
# Convert OS.status to a categorical factor so table1 displays counts/percentages
dat_simple$OS.status <- as.factor(dat_simple$OS.status)

# Optional: If you want to explicitly name the 0/1 levels, you can use this instead:
# dat_simple$OS.status <- factor(dat_simple$OS.status, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Alive", "Dead"))

label(dat_simple$Age.at.Diagnosis.in.Years)   <- "Age at Diagnosis (Years)"
label(dat_simple$Sex)                         <- "Sex"
label(dat_simple$Race)                        <- "Race"
label(dat_simple$Ethnicity)                   <- "Ethnicity"
label(dat_simple$Insurance)                   <- "Insurance Status"
label(dat_simple$Tumor.Specimen.Type)         <- "Tumor Specimen Type"
label(dat_simple$CNS.Status)                  <- "CNS Status"
label(dat_simple$Risk.Group)                  <- "Risk Group"
label(dat_simple$ETP.STATUS)                  <- "ETP Status"
label(dat_simple$Treatment.Arm)               <- "Treatment Arm"

# Variables tracking morphological response and MRD
label(dat_simple$Day.29.morphologic.Response) <- "Day 29 Morphologic Response"
label(dat_simple$Induction.Status)            <- "Induction Status (Categorical)"
label(dat_simple$Day.29.MRD)                  <- "Day 29 MRD (%)"
label(dat_simple$MRD)                         <- "Day 29 MRD (Categorical)"

# Survival and Outcome Variables
label(dat_simple$OS)                          <- "Time Until Death"
label(dat_simple$OS.status)                   <- "Died"
label(dat_simple$Cause.of.Death)              <- "Cause of Death (Raw)"
label(dat_simple$Death.Type)                  <- "Cause of Death"
label(dat_simple$EFS)                         <- "Event-Free Survival (Time)"
label(dat_simple$EFS.status)                  <- "Event-Free Survival Status"
label(dat_simple$Event.Type)                  <- "Event Type"
label(dat_simple$DFS)                         <- "Disease-Free Survival (Time)"
label(dat_simple$DFS.status)                  <- "Disease-Free Survival Status"
```

# Table 1

```{r}
table1(~ Age.at.Diagnosis.in.Years + Sex + Race + Ethnicity + Insurance + 
         Tumor.Specimen.Type + CNS.Status + Risk.Group + ETP.STATUS + 
         Treatment.Arm +
         Induction.Status + Day.29.morphologic.Response + 
         MRD  + 
         OS.status + OS + Death.Type 
        , 
       data = dat_simple)

```

# Gene Expression

```{r}
# Calculate summary statistics per sample
qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(dat_gexp),
  Total_Expression = colSums(dat_gexp),
  Detected_Genes = colSums(dat_gexp > 0),
  Mean_Expression = colMeans(dat_gexp)
)

# Output a clean HTML/Markdown table using knitr
kable(qc_summary, format = "markdown", digits = 2, 
      caption = "Sample Quality Control Metrics")
```

# Organizing CompRisk

```{r}
dat_cr <- dat %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  filter(!is.na(EFS), !is.na(EFS.status))

# Paper reports n = 1309; 26 additional exclusions are not identifiable from annot alone
stopifnot(nrow(dat_cr) == 1335)

cause_levels <- c("None", "Relapse", "Toxic Death", "Induction failure",
                  "Second Malignant Neoplasm", "Death NOS")

dat_cr <- dat_cr %>%
  mutate(
    event_type = factor(
      if_else(Event.Type == "Induction death", "Death NOS", Event.Type),
      levels = cause_levels
    ),
    tte = EFS
  )

cause_map <- c(
  status_relapse           = "Relapse",
  status_toxic_death       = "Toxic Death",
  status_induction_failure = "Induction failure",
  status_smn               = "Second Malignant Neoplasm",
  status_death_nos         = "Death NOS"
)

for (col in names(cause_map)) {
  cause <- cause_map[[col]]
  dat_cr[[col]] <- as.integer(case_when(
    dat_cr$event_type == cause  ~ 1L,
    dat_cr$event_type == "None" ~ 0L,
    TRUE                        ~ 2L
  ))
}

dat_cr <- dat_cr %>%
  select(sample_id, tte, event_type, all_of(names(cause_map)))
```

```{r}
status_cols <- names(cause_map)

stopifnot(all(sapply(status_cols, \(col) sum(dat_cr[[col]] == 0) == 1115)))

expected_ones <- c(status_relapse = 123, status_toxic_death = 26,
                   status_induction_failure = 38, status_smn = 22, status_death_nos = 11)
stopifnot(all(mapply(\(col, n) sum(dat_cr[[col]] == 1) == n, status_cols, expected_ones)))

n_ones <- rowSums(dat_cr[status_cols] == 1L)
stopifnot(all(n_ones <= 1))
stopifnot(all((n_ones == 0) == apply(dat_cr[status_cols], 1, \(r) all(r == 0))))
stopifnot(all(dat_cr$tte > 0))
stopifnot(!anyNA(dat_cr))

tibble(
  cause = names(expected_ones),
  n     = as.integer(expected_ones),
  pct   = round(100 * n / nrow(dat_cr), 1)
) %>% kable(caption = "Competing-risk cause counts (n = 1335)")
```

# Organizing Design Matrix

```{r}
dat_design <- dat_simple %>%
  select(Age = Age.at.Diagnosis.in.Years,
         Sex,
         Race,
         Ethnicity,
         Insurance, 
         Tumor.Specimen.Type,
         CNS.Status,
         Risk.Group,
         Treatment.Arm)%>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "id")%>%
  left_join(t(dat_gexp)%>%
              as.data.frame()%>%
              rownames_to_column(var = "id"),
            by = "id")%>%
  filter(id %in% dat_cr$sample_id)%>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "id")
  

```

```{r}
dat_design <- dat_design %>%
  filter(!is.na(Insurance) & !is.na(Treatment.Arm))

dat_cr <- dat_cr %>%
  filter(sample_id %in% rownames(dat_design))
```
